# Website Health Check: Robert R. Rickards, DMD

## What we saw on 13 November 2026
- Operating on Google Maps as "Rickards Robert R DDS": 196 Riva Ave, Milltown, NJ 08850, (732) 297-7788, dentist, rated 4.6, open with a 5 PM close.
- rickardsdentistry.com, the practice's old website address, now redirects to geometrysspot.com, an unrelated Indonesian-language online gambling site; nothing there mentions the practice.
- The domain is still registered (GoDaddy, expires 6 December 2026); the Internet Archive shows the practice's own site on it as recently as 6 June 2026.
- The Google listing has no website attached ("Add website" prompt) and is unclaimed; one directory still shows rickardsdentistry.com as the practice site.

## What it means for customers
Anyone who types or clicks the old address lands on a gambling page and may think the office has closed. The only reliable route to the practice is the phone number on the Google listing, which links to no site.

## How to fix it
1. Find out who holds the registrar account for the domain, and whether it is still in the practice's name (0.5-1.5 hours).
2. Renew now: it expires 6 December 2026 (0.25-0.5 hours).
3. If it is still yours, reset the password, add two-factor authentication and remove the redirect (1-3 hours).
4. If it cannot be recovered quickly, stop linking to it and register a new domain (1-2 hours), then build a one-page site with the address, tap-to-call number, hours and a request form (3-8 hours).
5. Claim the Google profile and attach the site, then add monitoring (1-2 hours).

## After the fix
Claim the Google Business Profile and attach the new site. It currently offers no website link and no online appointment request, so new patients must phone during office hours.

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
